description: This file defines interfaces and a template class for a synchronous communication channel within the WPEFramework core namespace. It includes interface definitions for outbound and inbound messages, a template class for managing synchronized message exchange, and internal classes for message framing and state management.

classes.name: IOutbound
classes.description: Interface for outbound messages with methods for serialization and reloading.

classes.name: IOutbound::ICallback
classes.description: Callback interface for outbound message updates.

classes.name: IInbound
classes.description: Interface for inbound messages with methods for deserialization and completion status.

classes.name: SynchronousChannelType
classes.description: Template class implementing a synchronized communication channel based on a generic CHANNEL.

classes.name: SynchronousChannelType::Frame
classes.description: Internal class representing a message frame with state, timing, and callback management.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes outbound data into a stream.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads or resets the outbound message.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes inbound data from a stream.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the inbound message has completed processing.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Performs message exchange with optional response handling.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a message from the queue.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message with optional callback and response.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Returns the descriptor of the resource.
